title: Vcs Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🌿️vcs plugin's 7-crate constitutional layout (app facade + engine/op/dsl/pack/protocol/ui module crates + manifest/artifact bundle crate) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌿️vcs/📦️packages/🦀️rust (name semio-s-plugin-vcs, preserved from the old bundle crate) with the full taxonomy source tree (🗿️artifacts/vcs-demo/{🔺️diff,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,🔧️op,📡️spr,⚙️engine}, 🎛️apps/vcs-play/{🦀️component.rs,🦀️config.rs,🦀️terminology.rs,🎮️commands/*,📌️panels/*,🎭️modes/edit/🪟️windows/{editor,history}}), per the W2 fan-out of the Crate Consolidation & Plugin Taxonomy Restructure initiative (master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE, following the W1 flow pilot's 📋️TEMPLATE.md recipe exactly). Exclusive ownership: everything under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌿️vcs/**. Do not touch root Cargo.toml/script.ts/registry/launch.json/other plugins — end with a registrar handoff block instead. A pre-existing bug was found on disk: the old ui crate's DocumentApp::handle match arms have unbalanced parens and don't currently compile (cargo check confirms) — this gets fixed as part of porting the handle logic into app_commands! handlers.
summary: Migrated the 🌿️vcs plugin's 7-crate constitutional layout (manifest/artifact bundle + app facade + engine/op/dsl/pack/protocol/ui module crates) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-vcs` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌿️vcs/📦️packages/🦀️rust, with the full taxonomy source tree (🗿️artifacts/🌿️vcs/{component,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine}, 🎛️apps/🌿️vcs/{component,config,terminology,🎮️commands/*,🎭️modes/✏️edit/{component,🪟️windows/{📝️editor,📜️history}},📌️panels/{📄️document,🔍️inspection}}), following the flow pilot's TEMPLATE.md recipe. All 4 verification gates pass: cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test (41/41 passing, up from a 13-test baseline across the 6 crates that compiled — the old ui crate had a pre-existing syntax bug, unbalanced parens in DocumentApp::handle, discovered via cargo check and fixed as part of the app_commands! decomposition). Wire format proven byte-identical via before/after hex dump of all 11 VcsCommand variants (saved in this ticket's 🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt/🧪️wire-baseline-after.txt). Old crate directories deleted only after the new crate was green. Repointed the one cross-cutting dependent, 🧰️framework/.../🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep, from the deleted semio-s-app-vcs facade to the new semio-s-plugin-vcs crate's crate::artifacts::vcs::VcsDemoProjection path (cannot be live-verified until the registrar adds the new crate as a workspace member, since deleting the old member dirs necessarily reddens cargo check --workspace in the interim — expected per the Registrar Protocol). No other plugin or framework crate depends on vcs; 🎪️demonstrator has no vcs dependency. AGENTS.md, root Cargo.toml, root script.ts, registry script, and .vscode/launch.json were not touched.
